subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should these MCP adapters share a standardized stderr diagnostic envelope while retaining distinct adapter identifiers, or should their diagnostic formatting remain adapter-owned?
rationale: Source review distinguishes shared transport mechanics from adapter-specific diagnostic identity, and code alone does not establish whether that identity is a supported operational contract.

options.title: Standardize with identity
options.body: Define one shared diagnostic helper that requires an adapter identifier and preserves attributable stderr output.

options.title: Keep adapter-owned logs
options.body: Leave the small formatting differences local because each adapter owns its operational diagnostic identity.

recommendation.title: Standardize with identity
recommendation.body: Define one shared diagnostic helper that requires an adapter identifier and preserves attributable stderr output.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent MCP protocol-output work makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for defining the shared diagnostics boundary.
